correctness.rationale: The quantified theorem is reduced to four non-vertex-transitive regular graph types. Exhaustive graph enumeration is exact, every Cayley--Menger polynomial identity is certified by exact integer determinant evaluation at seven points with a proved degree bound of six, and the remaining real-parameter implications follow algebraically. Degenerate roots are excluded by the explicit nondegeneracy hypothesis.

value.rationale: The result treats the first dimension beyond Edmonds' proved range and completely resolves a natural structural subclass: all vertex-uniform simplices with at most two edge lengths. The restriction is mathematically motivated because it is equivalent to regular two-colorings of K_8, and the theorem identifies the exact obstruction in every nontransitive coloring rather than checking an arbitrary finite sample.
